_comment: Optional presentation + citation config for the ThemeRiver app. The build step (scripts/build-manifest.js) scans data/*-counts.csv to discover which datasets exist; this file only controls labels, ordering, the default selection, and the metadata copied into data/manifest.json. Adding a new dataset requires nothing here — it appears with a prettified label — but you may add an entry to give it a nicer name or ordering.

meta.title: MIDAS ThemeRiver
meta.description: Research themes in infectious-disease modeling papers by MIDAS Network members over time, extracted from PubMed metadata.
